observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox One X console with a black controller on top, placed on a red tufted couch. The console has a visible 'X' logo on the front right.
Photo 1 shows the same console with a different controller (gold and black) on top, also on the red couch. The console's front logo is not clearly visible.
Both photos show a watermark 'LOVE FOR GADGET' across the image.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or damage in the photos.
The controllers are black and appear to be standard Xbox controllers, but the second one has a gold accent on the analog sticks and D-pad, which is not typical for Xbox One X.

identity.kind: Xbox One X console with one controller

claims.claim: Mint neatly used 2 units of Xbox One X with One Controller each and batteries
claims.evidence: The photos show two consoles and two controllers, but the second controller has a gold accent not typical for Xbox One X, suggesting it may be a different model or a custom version. The 'mint neatly used' condition is not verifiable from the photos alone. Batteries are not shown.

risks.risk: The second controller may not be an Xbox One X controller, or may be a different model altogether.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the second controller showing the model name or serial number, or a photo of the console's front label to confirm the model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if only one controller is included, or as a mismatched set, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The consoles may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game, or a photo of the console's serial number and model label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: The batteries may be missing or degraded, or the controllers may not hold charge.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the controllers plugged in and charging, or a photo of the battery compartment and battery condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if batteries are not included or are dead, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually on the back or side of the console.
A clear photo of the front label of the console to confirm the model.
A video showing the console powering on and running a game.
A photo of the second controller's model name or serial number.
A photo of the battery compartment and battery condition.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
